tools.name: make_set
tools.description: Makes a urlhub set from links: a short link that opens a page with every link's picture, title and description, and its QR code as PNG and SVG files. Good when several links should travel together: sent to someone, opened later on a phone, or printed as one QR code on a poster or a slide (gift ideas

tools.name: read_set
tools.description: Reads a urlhub link someone gives you (a short link /c/…, a published page /l/…, a featured set /s/…, or an address with ?urls=) and returns its links with their titles and descriptions as Markdown.

tools.name: preview_links
tools.description: Reads up to 50 links and returns each one's title, description, site and kind (page, video…), or why it could not be read. Useful before making a set, to check the links work and describe them, or to see what links someone sent are about.

tools.name: featured_sets
tools.description: Lists urlhub's ready sets of the season in a language (gift ideas, films, events, lessons…), each with its address and a short description: links to point someone to who asks for ideas on one of these topics.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_set · Private data: make_set · Public sink: make_set.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_set · Private data: make_set · Public sink: make_set

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
